refactor(providers): normalize video provider init logging (#4545)

* refactor(providers): normalize video provider init logging

Carried-forward debt from PR #4534 (batch 8 video/feed split). The
three `.initialize()` catchError sites for personalEventCacheService,
likesRepository, and repostsRepository wrap local-DB reads + persistent
relay subscriptions — expected network/IO failures under the
error-handling matrix, so they should be Log.warning, not Log.error,
to avoid polluting the SEVERE bucket.

Tags renamed from the stale 'AppProviders' (post-move artifact) to
per-component tags matching the convention used by sibling split-out
provider files (auth_providers, moderation_providers, curation_providers).

Closes #4544.

* chore(providers): regenerate video_providers.g.dart

Riverpod's @riverpod codegen hashes the provider function body to
invalidate consumers when the implementation changes. The three log
string + tag edits from the previous commit changed the hashes for
personalEventCacheServiceProvider, likesRepositoryProvider, and
repostsRepositoryProvider; regenerate the .g.dart so it matches.

* refactor(providers): normalize notification init logging

* test(settings): harden invite generation tap test

commit.message:
refactor(logging): route raw print through unified_logger (#4521)

* refactor(logging): route raw print/debugPrint/developer.log through unified_logger

Closes #3346.

## What changed

Migrated all production app and package code away from raw print(),
debugPrint(), and dart:developer log() to Log.debug/info/warning/error
via unified_logger. This ensures every log message is:
- subject to category filtering and production verbosity controls
- captured in the 50k-entry memory ring buffer (used for bug reports)
- consistently named and categorised

## Files touched

**mobile/lib/** (21 files, ~38 call sites):
- Deleted double-logging debug scaffolding in video_loading_metrics.dart
  (print() alongside existing UnifiedLogger.info() calls, plus the
  METRICS_TEST_OUTPUT test probe string)
- Migrated main.dart, native_proofmode_service, video_event_service,
  nip07_service, analytics_service, api_service, bandwidth_tracker_service,
  video_format_preference, connection_status_service, crash_reporting_service,
  error_analytics_tracker, startup_coordinator, feature_flag_service,
  video_event_extensions, subtitle_providers, pooled_fullscreen_video_feed_screen,
  new_message_search_bloc, sounds_tab, branded_loading_indicator,
  classic_viners_slider

**mobile/packages/** (17 packages, ~180 call sites):
- Added unified_logger dep to: keycast_flutter, models, pooled_video_player,
  media_cache, infinite_video_feed, videos_repository, notification_repository,
  people_lists_repository, reposts_repository, likes_repository,
  hashtag_repository, image_metadata_stripper, nostr_key_manager,
  nostr_app_bridge_repository, divine_camera, hls_auth_web_player,
  tv_static_effect, sound_service
- nostr_sdk and nostr_client intentionally excluded (publishable SDK
  packages; cannot depend on app-internal unified_logger)

## Lint

mobile/analysis_options.yaml: avoid_print: false -> true

## Regression guard

Added mobile/scripts/check_raw_logging.sh — exits non-zero if any
production .dart file outside the documented exceptions imports
dart:developer, calls debugPrint(), or calls print() directly.

* fix(logging): remove spurious closing brace in notification_repository

Edit during logging migration accidentally closed the class early,
stranding all static helper methods outside the class body and
causing a parse error.

* style(logging): apply dart format to logging migration changes

* fix(logging): resolve CI analyzer failures from logging migration

- Remove unused cacheStackTrace catch variable in infinite_video_feed
- Remove invalid level: 800 param from Log.debug in audio_playback_service
  (Log.debug has no level: param; 800 is the debug level it already implies)
- Sort unified_logger imports alphabetically to satisfy directives_ordering
  lint in likes_repository, reposts_repository, people_lists_repository_impl,
  platform_secure_storage, secure_key_storage

* chore(gen): regenerate subtitle_providers.g.dart after import change

* fix(logging): exempt test/ from avoid_print lint

CI runs 'flutter analyze lib test integration_test' so the avoid_print
rule we enabled was flagging legitimate print() calls in test fixtures
and benchmark helpers. Add test/analysis_options.yaml that inherits all
other rules but sets avoid_print: false — test output is expected there.

* fix(l10n): replace raw string concatenation with interpolation in locale test

Fixes unnecessary_raw_strings and prefer_interpolation_to_compose_strings
lint warnings introduced when avoid_print was enabled and test/ gained
its own analysis_options.yaml that applies the full rule set.

* fix(logging): address review feedback on logging migration

Four issues raised in code review:

**models ⇄ unified_logger cycle (breaking)**
Remove unified_logger from models/pubspec.yaml. unified_logger already
depends on models, so the reverse dep created a package cycle and dragged
a Flutter-dependent package into a shared leaf data package.
pending_upload.dart reverts to developer.log (level: 1000) which is
correct for a package that cannot take the unified_logger dep.

**55 Log.debug calls on hot parse path (perf)**
Delete all Log.debug calls from video_event.dart. These were parse-time
debug probes that existed before this PR as developer.log calls. Migrating
them 1:1 to Log.debug was wrong: UnifiedLogger._log always allocates a
LogEntry and writes it into the always-on 50k in-memory ring buffer even
in release, turning debug noise into steady allocation churn on the feed
scroll path. The debug probes are deleted entirely rather than migrated.

**cacheStackTrace dropped in InfiniteVideoFeed (correctness)**
Restore catch (cacheError, cacheStackTrace) and pass stackTrace to
Log.error. The stack trace was accidentally dropped when removing the
unused_catch_stack warning; it belongs here — cache-corruption failures
are exactly where a stack trace is useful for debugging.

**Regression guard not enforced in CI (guard gap)**
Wire check_raw_logging.sh into .github/workflows/mobile_ci.yaml in the
generated-files job alongside check_native_transport_security.sh.
Also fix the print() grep to use a Perl-compatible negative lookbehind
so comment lines (// print(...) and /// print(...)) are not flagged as
violations, and add models/ to the documented exception list.

* style(logging): dart format video_event.dart after debug call removal

* fix(logging): migrate divine_video_player linux backend to unified_logger

linux_video_player_backend.dart was added to origin/main after this branch
was cut and contained two developer.log calls that the CI guard caught on
the runner. Add unified_logger dep and migrate both calls to Log.warning.

* style: dart format all files

* fix(logging): clean up video_event.dart and wrap ListTile in Material in VineBottomSheetActionMenu

- models: remove unused dart:developer import, dead debug loop (tagName), and unused catch clause (e)
- divine_ui: wrap ListTile in Material(color: transparent) to prevent ListTile+ColoredBox assertion from Flutter framework

* style(format): restore enum semicolons to Dart 3.7.x style for CI compatibility

The CI pins Flutter 3.41.9 (Dart 3.7.x) whose formatter places the trailing
semicolon of enum bodies on its own line when the enum is split across lines.
Dart 3.12.0 (local) consolidates it onto the last value line. Restore the
Dart 3.7.x layout so the CI format check passes.

* fix(models): remove dead video event logging cleanup

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
refactor(providers): split video & feed providers out of app_providers.dart (#4534)

Eighth batch of #4506. Moves the 16-entity video/feed cluster to
`lib/providers/video_providers.dart`:

Leaves:
- videoFilterBuilder, videoVisibilityManager
- seenVideosService, brokenVideoTracker, videoLocalStorage
- personalEventCacheService

Keystone (80 external consumers — most-consumed provider in the codebase):
- subscriptionManager
- videoEventService

Publishers:
- videoEventPublisher, viewEventPublisher
- subscribedListVideoCache
- videoSharingService
- videoMetadataUpdateService

Repositories:
- videosRepository (uses createBlockedAuthorFilter — see below)
- likesRepository, repostsRepository

The `_createBlockedAuthorFilter` helper is renamed to public
`createBlockedAuthorFilter` and stays in `app_providers.dart` because
two non-video providers (`curatedListRepository`, `peopleListsRepository`)
also call it. `videosRepository` in the new file calls it via the
back-import.

`app_providers.dart` adds `import 'video_providers.dart';` (back-import
for `analyticsService`, `hashtagService`, `curationRepository`, and other
internal consumers of `viewEventPublisherProvider`,
`videoEventServiceProvider`, `likesRepositoryProvider`) and
`export 'video_providers.dart';` (keeps 107 external consumer files
unchanged).

Mutual import with `app_providers.dart`: new file imports for
`databaseProvider`, `profileRepositoryProvider`, `funnelcakeApiClientProvider`,
`pendingActionServiceProvider`, `uploadManagerProvider`,
`blossomUploadServiceProvider`, `savedSoundsServiceProvider`,
`ogVinerCacheServiceProvider`, `curatedListsStateProvider`,
`dmRepositoryProvider`. Dart resolves library-level mutual imports lazily.

Removed via `dart fix --apply`: 20+ now-unused service/repository imports
from `app_providers.dart`. Also removed redundant imports in the new file
(moderation/preferences/relay/auth re-exported transitively via
`app_providers.dart`).

Codegen moved: 16 *Provider chunks (~951 LoC) relocated from
`app_providers.g.dart` into `video_providers.g.dart`.

Two follow-up findings (rolled into existing lists):
1. `videoEventService` factory uses 5 `service.setX()` calls + an inline
   `addVideoObserver` observer bridge for OG Viner cache learning. Already
   tracked under #3334 (split VideoEventService into focused boundaries).
2. `personalEventCacheService.initialize` and `likesRepository.initialize`
   `catchError` log at `Log.error` for expected network/IO init failures.
   Per error_handling.md matrix, should be `Log.warning`. Joins the
   init-style inconsistency follow-up.

Refs #4506, #4339 Wave 2

commit.message:
fix(linux): ensure linux apps can startup (#4528)

* fix(linux): ensure linux apps can startup

refactor(platform): centralize Linux/Windows guards in platform_support

Extract repeated 'isFirebaseSupported' and 'hasNativeVideoPlayer' checks
into a new web-safe helper (lib/utils/platform_support.dart) so main.dart,
crash_reporting_service.dart, and app_providers.dart share a single source
of truth instead of duplicating defaultTargetPlatform comparisons.

- New helper uses only package:flutter/foundation.dart (no dart:io), so it
  stays safe under the web conditional import in main.dart.
- Renames configureVideoPlayerCacheForStartup parameter 'isWeb' to 'skip'
  so it matches the broader 'no native video plugin' meaning.
- Adds tests for both helpers covering Android/iOS/macOS/Linux/Windows.
- Adds an inline comment to the cryptography_flutter Linux stub
  explaining why the plugin returns NotImplemented (Dart side falls back
  to package:cryptography).

fix(provider): update hash for PushNotificationSyncProvider

* fix(linux): skip startup video cleanup on unsupported platforms

---------

commit.message:
fix(feed): refresh following feed when follow repo initializes late (#4520)

* fix(feed): refresh following feed when follow repo initializes late

On cold start, VideoFeedBloc._onStarted unconditionally used .skip(1) on
followingStream, dropping the first emission even when FollowRepository
hadn't finished initialize() yet. If the Funnelcake /feed endpoint
returned stale or popular-fallback content (because the server's
follow-graph index wasn't ready), no corrective refresh ever fired and
the Following feed showed the same content as For You.

Fix: capture isInitialized before subscribing and use .skip(0) when the
repo was not yet initialized. The first post-initialize() emission then
reaches _onFollowingListChanged, which performs a skipCache refresh with
the real follow list.

When the repo was already initialized at startup time the existing
.skip(1) behaviour is preserved to avoid a redundant second API call.

Closes #4324

* fix(feed): ignore unchanged initial follow replay

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

refactor(providers): split auth & identity providers out of app_providers.dart (#4532)

* refactor(providers): split auth & identity providers out of app_providers.dart

Seventh batch of #4506. Moves the 21-entity auth/identity cluster to
`lib/providers/auth_providers.dart`:

Foundational:
- secureKeyStorage, flutterSecureStorage, secureKeycastStorage
- oauthConfig, oauthClient
- pendingVerificationService, passwordResetListener, emailVerificationListener
- webAuthService, nostrKeyManager

Keystone:
- authService (the most-consumed provider in the codebase)
- currentAuthState, currentAuthRpcCapability (auth-stream bridges)
- knownAccounts (async list)

Identity adjuncts:

refactor(providers): split relay & connection providers out of app_providers.dart (#4530)

* refactor(providers): split relay & connection providers out of app_providers.dart

Fifth batch of #4506. Moves the relay/connection infrastructure cluster to
`lib/providers/relay_providers.dart`:

- connectionStatusService
- relayCapabilityService
- backgroundActivityManager
- relayStatisticsService
- relayStatisticsStream (Stream<Map<String, RelayStatistics>>)
- relayStatisticsBridge (@keepAlive eager — app-shell-activated)
- relaySetChangeBridge (@keepAlive eager — debounced reconnect+reset)
- _setsEqual<T> file-private helper

`videoFilterBuilder` and `videoVisibilityManager` are deliberately left in
`app_providers.dart` (they sit interleaved between relayCapability and
backgroundActivityManager in the source). They are video-domain providers
and will move with batch 8 (Video & Feed).

`app_providers.dart` adds both `import 'relay_providers.dart';` and
`export 'relay_providers.dart';`. The import is needed because four
remaining providers in `app_providers.dart` still consume
`connectionStatusServiceProvider`, and `videoFilterBuilder` still consumes
`relayCapabilityServiceProvider`. The export keeps all existing consumer
import paths working unchanged.

Removed now-unused imports from `app_providers.dart`:
`background_activity_manager`, `connection_status_service`,
`relay_capability_service`, `relay_statistics_service`. Narrowed the
`nostr_client` import show-list from `NostrClient, RelayConnectionStatus,
RelayState` down to just `NostrClient`.

Codegen moved: 7 Provider chunks relocated from `app_providers.g.dart`
into `relay_providers.g.dart`.

Three follow-up findings (out of scope for this PR, will be filed
separately):
1. Both bridge providers (relayStatisticsBridge and relaySetChangeBridge)
   contain repository-layer state-machine logic embedded in providers —
   same shape as the dirty-sync bridge from batch 4. Candidates for
   extraction into NotifierService/Coordinator classes.
2. backgroundActivityManagerProvider has zero consumers anywhere; the
   underlying singleton is reached via the static factory in
   analytics_service.dart. Joins notificationServiceEnhancedProvider
   from batch 4 in the dead-provider follow-up.
3. relaySetChangeBridge uses Log.error for an expected network failure
   (relay reconnect); per error_handling.md matrix this should be
   Log.warning.

Refs #4506, #4339 Wave 2

* refactor(providers): delete dead background activity provider

refactor(providers): split notifications providers out of app_providers.dart (#4526)

Fourth batch of #4506. Moves the entire 10-entity notifications cluster
to `lib/providers/notifications_providers.dart`:

- firebaseMessagingProvider, firebaseOnMessageProvider
- notificationServiceProvider
- notificationPreferencesStoreProvider (Hive-backed)
- pushNotificationServiceProvider (auth/session-gated)
- _updateNotificationPreferencesSafely (file-private helper)
- notificationPreferencesDirtySyncBridgeProvider (retry state machine)
- notificationPreferencesServiceProvider
- pushNotificationSync (@Riverpod keepAlive — eager FCM-and-coordinator)
- notificationServiceEnhanced (@riverpod — see notes)

The two preferences-side providers reference each other via lazy
`ref.read` callbacks; they must stay co-located. The file-private
`_updateNotificationPreferencesSafely` helper moves with them.

`app_providers.dart` adds `export 'notifications_providers.dart';`. No
back-import needed — no remaining provider in app_providers.dart
consumes a notifications symbol (the collaborator block that was
interleaved at lines 195-235 stays in app_providers.dart untouched).

The new file imports `app_providers.dart` for `authServiceProvider`,
`relayStatisticsServiceProvider`, `profileRepositoryProvider`,
`videoEventServiceProvider`, and imports `database_provider.dart`,
`environment_provider.dart`, `nostr_client_provider.dart` directly
for their respective providers (already-separated files).

Removed now-unused imports from app_providers.dart: firebase_messaging,
flutter/foundation (kIsWeb), notification_preferences (model),
notification_preferences_service, notification_service,
push_notification_service, push_notification_session_coordinator. Kept
notification_service_enhanced.dart because app_providers.dart still
calls `NotificationServiceEnhanced.instance.clearAllData()` from the
sign-out cleanup callback.

Codegen moved: pushNotificationSyncProvider and
notificationServiceEnhancedProvider relocated from app_providers.g.dart
into notifications_providers.g.dart.

Behavior preserved verbatim. Two follow-up issues to file separately:
1. Extract NotificationPreferencesDirtySyncCoordinator service — the
   95-line state-machine closure inside the bridge provider is
   repository-layer logic embedded in the providers layer.
2. Resolve dead notificationServiceEnhancedProvider — it has zero lib
   consumers; the singleton init never fires in production.

Refs #4506, #4339 Wave 2

Closes #3597

artifact into a small standalone PR so it can land against `main`
rather than waiting on the full #3530 docs draft. The other audit
docs in #3530 (architecture, performance, error-handling, testing,

content edits). Numbers reflect the audit baseline at PR-open time;
follow-up PRs can update them as decomposition lands.
